title: Ship the application
summary: Connect wallets through the current frontend path, understand the RPC contract, and add distribution, payments, or mobile support only when the product needs it.

links.description: Connect wallets with Wallet Standard and Kit plugins, with a documented bridge for legacy web3.js dependencies.
Use the authoritative request, response, commitment, and subscription reference for application data access.
Expose shareable transactions when distribution fits the product. The current @solana/actions line still depends on web3.js v1, so isolate it from a Kit-first client.
Choose among payment links, direct transfers, and agentic x402 flows using the current first-party payment map.
Add Mobile Wallet Adapter and mobile dApp support after confirming Android and native-platform constraints.
